### 🟡 Changes recommended A critical concurrency race can pair a stale recovery error with a healthy connection’s LinkID, causing a later retry to close that connection and its in-flight links.
1 open issue - [Read the error-associated LinkID under the recovery lock](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/pull/28008#discussion_r4540155122) · New
What changed in this PR This PR addresses [#27464](https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/issues/27464) by retaining connection and link revisions after failed Service Bus initialization, allowing retries to target the failed connection. **Changes:** - Preserve revision IDs when session creation, link initialization, or recovery fails. - Add four initialization/recovery regression cases and a namespace revision test. - Document the fix without changing `amqp:not-allowed` classification. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `sdk/​messaging/​azservicebus/​internal/​namespace.go` | Return the connection revision on session creation errors. | | `sdk/​messaging/​azservicebus/​internal/​namespace_test.go` | Verify failed session creation preserves the revision. | | `sdk/​messaging/​azservicebus/​internal/​amqpLinks.go` | Retain revision IDs across initialization and recovery failures. | | `sdk/​messaging/​azservicebus/​internal/​amqpLinks_test.go` | Cover session and link failures during setup and recovery. | | `sdk/​messaging/​azservicebus/​CHANGELOG.md` | Record the sender and receiver recovery fix. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: `RecoverIfNeeded` releases `links.mu` before this read, so another caller can recover successfully in between; this retry then pairs its old error with the successful caller's `LinkID`, and the next retry can close that healthy connection and its in-flight links. Capture and return the error-associated `LinkID` inside the recovery helper's existing critical section instead of rereading mutable state afterward, and add a regression covering concurrent successful recovery.
